title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
summary: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: SASE 增益練習：取 LCLS 硬 X 光模式 E = 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、峰值電流 I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm。共振波長 λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m，即 8.2 keV。Pierce 參數 ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。增益長度 L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m，112 m 的波盪器留有餘裕。飽和功率 P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W，30 fs 脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ；頻寬 ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV；70 fs 全寬脈衝的模式數 M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64，逐發能量抖動約 12%。若歸一化發射度 0.4 µm，幾何發射度 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm，略大於 λ/4π ≈ 12 pm，接近繞射極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: SASE gain exercise: take the LCLS hard X-ray mode with E = 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), peak current I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm. The resonant wavelength is λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m, that is 8.2 keV. The Pierce parameter ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. Gain length L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m, saturation after about 20L_g ≈ 60 m, so the 112 m undulator has margin. Saturated power P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W, about 0.57 mJ in a 30 fs pulse; bandwidth ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV; a 70 fs full-width pulse holds M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64 modes with about 12% shot-to-shot energy fluctuation. With a normalised emittance of 0.4 µm the geometric emittance is 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm, slightly above λ/4π ≈ 12 pm, close to the diffraction limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “112 m undulator and SASE gain” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “112 m undulator and SASE gain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FEL output power is proportional to undulator length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “112 m undulator and SASE gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 的共振條件要求整段波盪器的 K 值一致到 ρ 的量級，否則不同段輻射的波長錯開、增益中斷。LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。壓縮條件 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆：以 R₅₆ = −40 mm 的單級壓縮為例，C = 10 需啁啾 h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹，即每公尺束長 22.5 的相對能量斜率，兩級串聯得到 100 倍。雷射加熱器把切片能散從 3 keV 提到 20 keV，經 100 倍壓縮後仍只占 13.6 GeV 的 1.5×10⁻⁴，低於 ρ。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100. The compression condition is 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆: for one stage with R₅₆ = −40 mm, C = 10 needs a chirp h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹, a relative energy slope of 22.5 per metre of bunch, and two stages in series give 100. The laser heater raises the slice energy spread from 3 keV to 20 keV, which after hundredfold compression is still only 1.5×10⁻⁴ of 13.6 GeV, below ρ. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy.

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy. steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works.

steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」與「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" and "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。到達時間：直線加速器射頻相位抖動 0.1° 在 2.856 GHz 對應 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs，經壓縮器轉成數十飛秒的到達時間抖動，與 30 fs 的脈衝同量級，所以時序工具是必要的。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum. Arrival time: an RF phase jitter of 0.1° at 2.856 GHz corresponds to 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs, which the compressors convert into tens of femtoseconds of arrival-time jitter, comparable with the 30 fs pulse, so the timing tool is indispensable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 脈衝由許多彼此不相干的縱向模式（尖峰）組成，尖峰的持續時間約為同調時間，由頻寬 ρ 決定；脈衝能量的逐發相對抖動近似為 1/√M，M 是模式數。長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A SASE pulse consists of many mutually incoherent longitudinal modes (spikes); each spike lasts about one coherence time, set by the bandwidth ρ, and the shot-to-shot relative fluctuation of pulse energy is about 1/√M for M modes. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%.

steps.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模式數 M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π)：8.2 keV 時 ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s，ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴，脈衝全寬 T = 70 fs → M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64，能量抖動 ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%。T = 5 fs 時 M ≈ 4.6，抖動 ≈ 47%；M = 1 時抖動 100%。同調時間 τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs，對應合作長度 λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%. steps.instruction: 從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較；用單發光譜儀數尖峰數目與平均尖峰寬度核對同調時間；改變束團電荷或壓縮量，確認 M 隨脈衝長度線性變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated. steps.instruction: LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 安裝 1.3 GHz 的 TESLA 型超導加速模組（每模組 8 個九腔鈮腔，另加 3.9 GHz 線性化模組），以約 16 MV/m 的連續波梯度把電子加速到 4 GeV；腔體以氮摻雜製程把 Q₀ 提高到 2.7×10¹⁰ 以壓低 2 K 熱負載。模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: LCLS-II superconducting linac integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。每腔動態損耗 P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W（連續波），280 腔 ≈ 2.8 kW（2 K）；2 K 制冷以每瓦約 800 W 的壁上電力（教學假設）換算，低溫站需約 2.2 MW 的電力，加上靜態漏熱後需要 4 kW 等級的 2 K 容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities; each 1.038 m at 16 MV/m gives 16.6 MV per cavity and 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV in total, leaving margin for 4 GeV operation. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。若導向錯誤把束流集中在 1 mm² 的鋁腔壁上，100 µs 內沉積 40 J，足以把該體積加熱數千度；MPS 的反應時間必須遠小於此。光子端：100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W 平均功率落在第一面鏡子，與 120 Hz 時代 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W 相比高 400 倍，鏡面必須水冷並控制熱斜率誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. A steering error concentrating the beam on 1 mm² of aluminium chamber wall deposits 40 J within 100 µs, enough to heat that volume by thousands of degrees, so the MPS reaction must be far shorter. On the photon side, 100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W of average power lands on the first mirror, 400 times the 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W of the 120 Hz era, so mirrors must be water-cooled with controlled thermal slope error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. A steering error concentrating the beam on 1 mm² of aluminium chamber wall deposits 40 J within 100 µs, enough to heat that volume by thousands of degrees, so the MPS reaction must be far shorter. On the photon side, 100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W of average power lands on the first mirror, 400 times the 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W of the 120 Hz era, so mirrors must be water-cooled with controlled thermal slope error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power", which statement holds?
options: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
optionsEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.
An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
quiz.explanation: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。
knowledge.textEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間。
脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.
quiz.explanation: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.
Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
